pack.risks: unvalidated idea; tiny DEMO risk only

concerns: Hypothesis and falsification criteria are truncated mid-sentence, so the acceptance/rejection rule cannot be evaluated as written
Compound criterion mixes two distinct statistics (median adverse slippage > 1 spread-width AND mean R reduction >= 0.05) without specifying the logical link or which is primary
No stopping rule: '~200 closed trades' lacks a fixed-N commitment and interim-look policy, creating optional-stopping/peeking risk

Newly reconciled broker-triggered-exit telemetry may have systematic gaps (partial closes, missing signal-time quotes, clock skew between signal timestamps and fill records); no data-quality gate is stated
Slippage normalized against which spread — contemporaneous signal-time spread or the runner's static spread assumption? Ambiguity here can manufacture or erase the effect
~200 trades will span multiple symbols/sessions/regimes; pooled slippage may mask or fabricate the effect without pre-specified segmentation
'Affected files: bot/intel/' is vague; intel/ contains runtime artifacts governed elsewhere — writes should be scoped to research reports + ExperimentRegistry
votes.reason: The underlying idea is sound, safe, and well-aligned with AEGIS goals: it is an observational, read-only slippage audit over DEMO firehose trades using the newly reconciled broker-triggered-exit telemetry, with no changes to the execution path, risk config, live YAML, or champion gating. However, the proposal as submitted is materially incomplete — both current_evidence and proposed_change truncate mid-sentence ('slippage-adjusted exp…'), leaving the exact hypothesis, decision rule, and falsification criteria unspecified. Pre-registering an incomplete falsification rule invites post-hoc threshold selection, which conflicts with the lab's no-fabrication/no-lookahead discipline. Fixable with a precise resubmission; no safety objection.
requested_revisions: Resubmit with complete, untruncated hypothesis and falsification-criteria text
Pre-register the full analysis plan in ExperimentRegistry BEFORE including any trade: primary endpoint, test statistic, one-sided alpha, power/sample-size justification for N≈200
Decompose into two separately specified tests: (1) median adverse slippage in spread-widths, (2) slippage-adjusted mean R minus modeled mean R; state the decision rule for each
Add a data-quality gate: report signal-time-quote capture rate, timestamp-alignment checks, and % of trades excluded with reasons before computing any statistic
Specify spread normalization: use contemporaneous signal-time bid/ask spread as primary, runner's assumed spread as sensitivity check
Pre-specify segmentation (symbol, session, volatility bucket) and commit that the headline result is the pre-registered aggregate, with segments exploratory-only
Confirm read-only scope explicitly: no mt5.order_send() calls, no changes to execution/risk/champion-gating code, outputs limited to bot/reports/research/ and the experiment registry

concerns: Signal-time quote and actual-fill timestamps/sides must be normalized to avoid biased slippage estimates.
Stop-loss fills need a defined modeled-stop reference and treatment for gaps, partial fills, and broker-triggered exits.
~200 trades may be underpowered; median adverse slippage and mean-R thresholds require confidence intervals and pre-registration.
Affected paths include runtime intel/council areas; research collection must remain read-only and must not call MT5 order APIs or alter risk/cadence.
votes.reason: The proposal is research-only and DEMO-scoped, but its truncated specifications do not define the telemetry schema, fill/quote alignment, cost model, statistical decision rule, or safeguards against changing execution behavior.
requested_revisions: Provide a concrete read-only experiment specification with fields, timestamp tolerance, side-aware slippage formulas, missing-data rules, and net-cost assumptions.
Pre-register sample size, primary/secondary metrics, confidence intervals, and pass/fail criteria before collecting outcomes.
State explicitly that no execution settings, position sizing, champion artifact, or broker positions will be modified; record the experiment through ExperimentRegistry.
Add tests using synthetic market, stop, partial-fill, and missing-telemetry cases.

votes.reason: The experiment is directionally safe and appropriately falsifiable, but the proposal is truncated and lacks sufficient implementation detail to approve testing. It must explicitly guarantee research-only telemetry analysis, DEMO-only execution if any trades are involved, registry recording, cost/lookahead controls, and no champion promotion.

Define the 200-trade window, stopping/falsification rules, rollback behavior, and explicit prohibition on champion promotion or live-config changes.
